title: Year 9 Summer 1 unit quiz
subject: Mathematics
unit: Summer 1: Enlargement and similarity; ratio and proportion; rates
source: Seeded from mathematics/y9 lesson 69 (Year 9 Summer 1 unit quiz (portal quiz, secure mode, written for this unit))
intro: Covers lessons 52 to 69 of Enlargement and similarity; ratio and proportion; rates. Answer every question. For multiple choice, fill in one circle.

questions.q: A side of 5 cm is enlarged by scale factor 4. The image side is:
questions.a: A) 20 cm. 5 × 4 = 20. 9 adds 4 instead of multiplying.

questions.q: An image side is 3 cm and the object side is 12 cm. The scale factor is:
questions.a: A) ¼. 3 ÷ 12 = ¼. 4 divides the wrong way round (object ÷ image).

questions.q: An object side is 3 cm and its image side is 12 cm. The scale factor is:
questions.a: A) 4. 12 ÷ 3 = 4. 9 subtracts; ¼ divides the wrong way round.

questions.q: In two similar triangles, sides of 5 cm and 15 cm correspond. A side of 7 cm becomes:
questions.a: A) 21 cm. Scale factor 15 ÷ 5 = 3; 7 × 3 = 21. 17 adds 10 instead of multiplying.

questions.q: Every length is doubled. The area is multiplied by:
questions.a: B) 4. 2² = 4. 8 is the volume factor; 2 is the length factor.

questions.q: Every length is multiplied by 10. The volume is multiplied by:
questions.a: C) 1000. 10³ = 1000. 100 is the area factor.

questions.q: Simplify 0.6 : 1.5.
questions.a: A) 2 : 5. × 10 gives 6 : 15; ÷ 3 gives 2 : 5. 6 : 15 is not fully simplified.

questions.q: Share 60 in the ratio 1 : 3. The larger share is:
questions.a: A) 45. 4 parts, so 15 each; 3 × 15 = 45. 20 divides by 3 instead of 4.

questions.q: The ratio is 3 : 7. The first part is what fraction of the whole?
questions.a: A) 3/10. 3 + 7 = 10 parts, so 3/10. 3/7 compares the first part with the second.

questions.q: Map scale 1 : 10 000. 5 cm on the map is:
questions.a: A) 500 m. 5 × 10 000 = 50 000 cm = 500 m. 50 000 m forgets to convert from cm.

questions.q: Which table shows direct proportion?
questions.a: A) x: 1, 2, 3; y: 5, 10, 15. Only the first has y ÷ x = 5 every time. The second adds 2 each time (not through the origin); the third is inverse.

questions.q: 6 taps fill a tank in 10 minutes. 4 taps take:
questions.a: A) 15 minutes. Total 60 tap-minutes; 60 ÷ 4 = 15. 6.7 treats it as direct proportion.

questions.q: Which is NOT a proportion?
options: the time to boil one egg and the number of pans
the cost and the kilograms of rice
workers and the days to build one wall
questions.a: A) the time to boil one egg and the number of pans. More pans do not boil one egg faster. Rice cost is direct; workers and days are inverse.

questions.q: A cyclist travels 36 km in 1 h 30 min. Their average speed is:
questions.a: A) 24 km/h. 36 ÷ 1.5 = 24. 27.7 wrongly uses 1.3 hours.

questions.q: An object has mass 160 g and volume 20 cm³. Its density is:
questions.a: A) 8 g/cm³. 160 ÷ 20 = 8. 3200 multiplies; 0.125 divides the wrong way round.

questions.q: Which is fastest?
questions.a: A) 20 m/s. 20 m/s = 72 km/h and 1 km per minute = 60 km/h, so 20 m/s is fastest.

questions.q: Under an enlargement, angles:
questions.a: A) stay the same
options: are multiplied by the scale factor

questions.q: Scale factor ½ makes a shape:
questions.a: B) smaller

questions.q: To describe an enlargement fully, give:
questions.a: A) the scale factor and the centre
options: the scale factor and the centre

questions.q: Similar shapes have:
questions.a: A) equal angles and sides in the same ratio
options: equal angles and sides in the same ratio
